Element.Description: Selects constant, linear or quadratic distance attenuation for point and spot lights. Constant attenuation uses coefficient 1; linear and quadratic attenuation use the FalloffRate curve value in the selected coefficient.
Curve supplying the linear or quadratic distance-attenuation coefficient selected by FalloffType. Evaluated for active point and spot lights; constant falloff ignores the resulting value.
End time for the FalloffRate curve. At this time, FalloffRateLoops either resets the curve timer to zero or holds it at this value.
Restarts the FalloffRate curve at time zero when its timer reaches FalloffRateDuration. When disabled, the timer stays at FalloffRateDuration.
